name: 34933-loradecode-nemotronh30b-tp4
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16, bf16, 31.58B params, 63.16 GB of safetensors in 13 shards, ungated; 15.8 GB per rank at TP=4. Served with --enable-lora.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), driver 570.195.03. 80 GB per card does not bind at this load.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process vLLM engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 480 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -- 60 rounds of 600-token generation per stream, roughly 7 minutes of traffic. Seed static 34933.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, text only: exactly 1600 prompt tokens in and exactly 600 tokens out (min == max on both ends), no shared prefix, chat-templated (`request_format: default-template`), temperature 0.0, `ignore_eos` so length cannot drift. NO ADAPTER IS ATTACHED TO REQUESTS: the engine is driven in-process, so the server is LoRA-enabled while every request is answered by the base weights.
purpose: A LoRA-capable 30-billion-parameter assistant drafting 600-token answers from 1600-token prompts for eight concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. The interpreter that has this commit built is named in env.yaml.

model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16

# Required: the checkpoint's config.json carries an `auto_map` to `configuration_nemotron_h`.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 4

enable-lora: true
max-loras: 1
max-lora-rank: 16
max-cpu-loras: 1
lora-dtype: auto

max-num-seqs: 128

# LOAD-BEARING -- do not drop this as "the default". Left unpinned it falls through to a scheduler
# floor of 2048, and a 1600-token prompt would then meet a four times smaller budget.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

max-model-len: 262144

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95

enable-prefix-caching: false

async-scheduling: true

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE of inline JSON. The config reader is flat and skips indented lines, so a
# block mapping here is dropped silently and the engine starts without it at rc=0.
compilation-config: {"compile_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128], "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128]}

dtype: bfloat16
